review_fixes: countEvery is modeled as zero-input source-row counting through List/table/combine/group/repeat/forEach rather than consuming a fictitious selected column
Repeated and named copies count logical nodes and precharge row/name/output work; malformed unused fields and duplicate result names reject
Histogram counts distinct output keys once but still charges repeated hashing/comparisons/updates and exact public JSON growth
Product normalizes binary exponents; requested standard deviation does not require an overflowing variance intermediate
Finite leaves remain opaque and reject raster/Array/runtime contexts even on empty sources
validation_corrections: Initial workflow harness used the wrong Python ApiFunction.call instance method; changed the example/tests to the official ee.call helper; four initial fixture failures resolved

First broad run exposed two historical assertions that variance/stdDev were unsupported; updated to test actual population results, an unimplemented skew rejection and unchanged raster rejection; no scientific check removed
fidelity_notes: countEvery zero-input inference is based on the official reduceToVectors labels-only default, without a Google arity probe
forEach multi-output underscore separator is an explicit local convention; reference specifies prefixing without separator
Empty/null/countRuns gap/type/collision policies remain documented local rules, not Google oracle results
